auth.legal: By continuing, you agree to our <terms>Terms of Service</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
auth.googleFailed: Google sign-in didn’t go through. Try again or use email.
auth.googleNeedsBuild: Google sign-in works in the installed Espanda app, not in Expo Go. Use email for now.

language.title: App language
language.explainer: Changes the app's buttons and menus. Your posts keep the content language set for each brand.

net.unreachable: Can’t reach Espanda. Check your internet connection: we’ll keep trying.
net.timeout: Espanda took too long to answer. Check your connection and try again.
net.serverDown: Espanda isn’t responding right now. Try again in a minute.
net.offline: No connection. We’ll reconnect as soon as we can; nothing you’ve saved is lost.
net.signedOut: You were signed out. Sign in again to pick up where you were.

notFound.title: This screen doesn’t exist.
notFound.body: The link may be old, or the screen was moved.

crash.title: Something went wrong.
crash.body: This screen hit a problem. Try again; if it keeps happening, restart the app.
